scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 26 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 31 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
